decision.reason: The API directly retrieved CC0 metadata with an exact Canmahala Bay and Camarines Sur place string. This supports only historical named-feature place context. The selected records are non-fish specimens and do not establish the entire bay footprint, exclusive regional jurisdiction, or the exact collection point or identity of the ZooKeys fish lots.

limitations: The source records report Canmahala Bay with Camarines Sur but do not define a feature boundary or prove that the full bay is exclusively within the province.
No coordinates from a separate museum specimen or literature locality may be assigned to any 2025 checklist lot.
The selected API records are invertebrates, not fish records or fish-survey evidence.
No bay, stream, municipal-water, or provincial-water geometry was sourced.
The indexed leads do not establish current fish presence, a complete fish inventory, fishing access, legality, safety, diet, or bait suitability.
nextAction: Keep Canmahala Bay as a historical named-feature context anchor only; resolve Canmahana as a separate spelling variant and seek a primary locality source for Rogo Point and other unresolved names. Continue independent freshwater and marine evidence work in parallel.
